post.title: Byderma Concept A - Monumental Editorial
post.content:
Selected case · WordPress / WooCommerce

Byderma

A beauty platform where treatments, booking and ecommerce stay clear.

My role — WordPress Developer. I structured the WordPress and WooCommerce experience around distinct treatment, shopping and appointment journeys.

Visit Byderma All cases

ROLE
WordPress Developer

PLATFORM
WordPress + WooCommerce

FOCUS
Treatments · Shop · Booking

The challenge

One brand. Three different user intents.

ByDerma combines beauty treatments with a large WooCommerce product catalogue, appointments and member benefits. The main challenge was to keep treatment discovery, shopping and booking distinct enough to understand while still feeling like one consistent beauty platform.

My contribution

I made the separation part of the WordPress structure.

I structured the WordPress and WooCommerce experience around those separate tasks. Treatment information leads naturally to appointment booking, the webshop keeps product discovery and purchasing focused, and supporting account or membership content remains accessible without interrupting either journey. The same hierarchy stays clear on mobile.

Treatment → appointment

Treatment information leads naturally into booking.

The service journey stays distinct from ecommerce. Visitors can understand a treatment first, then move toward an appointment without the page turning into a shop experience.

What this case shows

Structure first. Interface second.

The live platform keeps treatment discovery, booking, ecommerce and member support recognisable as separate tasks inside one brand experience.

post.title: Byderma Concept B - Recruiter Split
post.content:
Case 01 · Beauty webshop

Byderma

WordPress Developer
WordPress · WooCommerce

Visit live site

I structured three competing user journeys into one clear platform.

ByDerma combines beauty treatments with a large WooCommerce product catalogue, appointments and member benefits. The main challenge was to keep treatment discovery, shopping and booking distinct enough to understand while still feeling like one consistent beauty platform.

My contribution
I structured the relationship between treatment discovery, appointment booking, the WooCommerce webshop and supporting member content — then preserved that hierarchy on mobile.

ROLE
WordPress Developer

PLATFORM
WordPress + WooCommerce

PROBLEM
Treatments · Shop · Booking

PRINCIPLE
Clear task separation

Problem

The user should always know what kind of task they are doing.

Treatment research, appointment booking and product shopping are related, but they should not collapse into one generic flow.

What I did

I encoded that separation in the WordPress experience.

I structured the WordPress and WooCommerce experience around those separate tasks. Treatment information leads naturally to appointment booking, the webshop keeps product discovery and purchasing focused, and supporting account or membership content remains accessible without interrupting either journey. The same hierarchy stays clear on mobile.

Recruiter takeaway

This is the kind of complexity I like to simplify.

Byderma shows how I translate mixed service and ecommerce requirements into a structured WordPress product that remains understandable across desktop and mobile.
